newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury up as Unilever sale renews bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury up as Unilever sale renews bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Cadbury Schweppes Plc rose on Tuesday on the back of better-than-expected figures from Unilever Plc and as the latter's planned sale of its chemical units renewed bid speculation around Cadbury, dealers said.
"The Unilever figures were good and with the chemical disposal people are talking about the possibility of a bid," said one market-maker in Cadbury shares.
With Unilever shares leaping 95-1/2p to 14.88-1/2 stg by 0901 GMT, Cadbury shares were up 10-1/2p at 487-1/2.
Elsewhere in the food manufacturing sector, Associated British Foods Plc -- like Cadbury a perennial favourite for bid speculation -- was up 15-1/2p 496-1/2 and United Biscuits was up 3p at 229.
Earlier Unilever, the Anglo-Dutch consumer products giant, posted a higher-than-expected 15 percent rise in 1996 pre-tax profit to 2.66 billion stg.
The company said it planned to sell its speciality chemical business, which had turnover of three billion stg in 1996 and employed some 15,800 people in over 35 countries.
